info.title: Dex Tracker API
info.description:
The backend for Dex Tracker, maintained by another team. It covers one trainer: their games, catches, friends, trades and shiny hunts, plus Pokémon reference data.

- All responses are JSON, except images under `/media/`. Errors are `{ "error": "..." }` with status 400, 404 or 409.
- Lists that page take `page` (1-based) and `pageSize`, and return `{ items, page, pageSize, total, totalPages }`. A page past the end returns no items.
- Every `/api` response takes about 30 ms, like a real service. Responses are `Cache-Control: no-store`: the data changes, including through the POST endpoints.
- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` strings. The data has its own current date (`today` in /api/me and /api/meta).
- Image URLs in responses are absolute. Images can be cached.
- CORS is open, so browsers can call the API directly.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `wild`: catchable in an owned game. `friends`: a friend has one. `trade-evolution`: evolves by trade.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `dex`: by National Pokédex number. `friends`: most friends first, then by number.

wildIn.description: Owned games where it can be caught in the wild, in release order

anyOf.description: Set when it evolves from another species by trade

total.description: Number of matching items across all pages

totalPages.description: At least 1, even when total is 0

totalPages.description: At least 1, even when total is 0

wild.description: Catchable in the wild (per the encounter data, which is missing for some newer games)

total.description: Number of matching items across all pages

post.description: Creates the trade and a catch (method `Trade`) of what you received. Trades logged this way never evolve.

game.description: Id of a game you own

tradedAt.description: Defaults to today; can't be later

total.description: Number of matching items across all pages

totalPages.description: At least 1, even when total is 0

post.summary: Add encounters to an active hunt

id.description: API name of the game, such as `scarlet`

anyOf.description: Absolute URL of the 96×96 front sprite
The ball it was caught in; null for trades
The trade it came from, for method `Trade`
The shiny hunt it came from

evolved.description: Whether what you received evolved on arrival (a trade evolution); `received` is the evolved species

encounters.description: Encounters (or eggs, or resets) so far

anyOf.description: How the previous stage evolves into this one, such as `Level 16` or `Trade holding Metal Coat`; null for the first stage

trade.description: Whether this evolution needs a trade

evolvesTo.description: Next stages; several for branching families such as Eevee

ActivityItem.description: A trade, a completed shiny hunt (`type: hunt`), or a catch that didn't come from a trade or hunt. Has the fields of the Trade, Hunt or Catch it describes, plus `type` and `date`.
